subject: Renewal + capacity add — TerraForge PO & invoice split
messages:

Cc: Alex Grant <alex.grant@terraforge.io>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: TerraForge renewal — added capacity & invoicing questions

Hi Nikhil,

We're finalizing the TerraForge renewal and adding the 1.5M token capacity block for Q3. Finance is preparing the PO but has a couple of asks before we can route payment: 

- Can Redwood issue invoices on Net45 instead of Net30 for this renewal?
- We'll provide a single PO, but we need the invoice split across two internal cost centers (R&D / Platform). Is it possible to receive two invoices tied to the same PO number?
- They also need a current W-9 and confirmation of Redwood's billing contact for purchase orders.

Attaching the draft PO our procurement team started (placeholder).

Attachment: TF_PO_draft_placeholder.pdf (pdf)

If you can confirm next steps, I'll send the official PO and cost-center breakdown. We need billing handled before Apr 30 to align with our month-end.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Director, Finance — TerraForge
elena.martinez@terraforge.io

--
TerraForge | finance@terraforge.io

Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TerraForge renewal — added capacity & invoicing questions

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the PO draft. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Net45 is fine for the renewal/commit. We'll update payment terms for the renewal invoice; please include the Net45 request on the PO.
- We can absolutely produce two invoices that reference the same PO number (one per cost center). Our billing ops needs the exact cost-center labels and billing addresses to populate the invoice lines.
- I'll attach the current Redwood W-9 for your records. Our canonical billing email for POs is billing@redwood.ai — please cc that address when you send the final PO so it routes automatically.

Action items from our side:
- I will loop in Monica (cc) to prepare a draft invoice split and validate tax fields (EIN).
- Marissa will confirm the contract amendment language for the capacity add and signoff path.

Can you send the official PO (PDF) with the two cost-center lines and the contact details for each payor? Once we have that we'll issue the two invoices and push them to the DocuSign amendment for signatures if needed.

Deal: RF-2027-931
Regards,
Nikhil Sharma

nkhil_sharma@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

- I created two invoice tabs in the attached spreadsheet (Invoice_R&D and Invoice_Platform) both referencing PO TF-45291. If you prefer two separate PDFs we can export accordingly.
- Please confirm the remit addresses and EIN for each cost center. We only need the single TerraForge EIN to stay on file (no vendor entity split on our side).
- We set payment terms to Net45. If TerraForge needs Net30 on either of the cost centers we can accommodate but would need approval from finance.

1) Which billing address to use for Platform (Alex — can you confirm ACH/contact)?
2) Confirm acceptance of two invoices referencing one PO (yes/no)

Hi Elena / Alex —

Thanks for the PO and the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and our plan so there's no surprises: 

- Redwood will issue two separate invoices (one per cost center) that both reference PO TF-45291. Each invoice will be a full accounting document (PDF) and will include the associated line items.
- Payment terms will be Net45 per the PO.
- Monica will finalize the invoice PDFs (attached draft previously) and upload to DocuSign so you can sign the contract amendment that adds the 1.5M token capacity.
- We'll send invoices to the billing email you provided and cc billing@terraforge.io. Please confirm Alex's ACH details by end of day so we can include correct remit instructions on the Platform invoice.

Related: HubSpot deal RF-2027-931 updated with PO# TF-45291 and attachments: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/RF-2027-931. Also preparing a DocuSign amendment (link below) for signature once invoices are finalized.

DocuSign (amendment): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/RF-2027-931-amendment

If I don't hear back from Alex on remit details by EOD we'll issue the R&D invoice first and hold Platform invoice for 48 hours pending ACH confirmation (so you can route internally).

Thanks — we'll aim to have final invoice PDFs in your inbox by Apr 16.

Best,
